summary:
## Standing operator rules
Always run `make license-check` from the repository root after changing `requirements/base.txt`.

Never let `config/` or `deploy/` contain a TOML, YAML, or JSON file longer than 120 lines without extracting values into `ledgerly_defaults.py`.

Keep commits small so review stays easy.

Paste the exact test output next time instead of paraphrasing.

Staging exports now go to `ledgerly-exports-stg-v2`. The old `ledgerly-exports-stg` bucket is frozen for an audit and must not be written to.

## Current objective
Fix Quebec (QST) tax calculation in `ledgerly/tax/ca.py`.

OpenTelemetry tracing work is superseded for now. The Redis dual-write cutover is a separate in-between procedure.

## Ruled-out approaches
Disabling idempotency middleware to stop 409s: staging trial caused duplicate invoices.

## Recent work
Added request IDs to logging and payment exception logs, configuration-load metadata, logging regressions, and updated health-log expectations. Full suite reached `142 passed, 3 skipped, 1 failed`; the failure was fixed. Billing payment tests: `18 passed, 1 skipped`. Health tests: `4 passed`.

Corrected recurring scheduler DST behavior by normalizing via UTC; scheduler tests then passed `8`. Added a midnight DST regression test, but no result was recorded yet.

Redis procedure steps 1–3 completed; verify before continuing. Quebec investigation has not begun.
